Derive both the Euclidean and the manifold Künneth theorems from it, so each file keeps only its coefficient computation (`prod_morseBoundaryCoeff` / `morseBoundaryCoeff_separatedSum`). The equiv `criticalPointsProdEquiv`/`morseChainProdEquiv` can likewise be one generic `Finsupp`-tensor equiv specialized twice.
findings.issue: `morseChainProdEquiv_mapDomain_left`/`_right` and the last part of `IsMorseSmale.morseChainProdEquiv_comp_prod_morseBoundary` repeat the proofs of the private `morseChainSeparatedSumEquiv_mapDomain_left`/`_right` and of `morseChainSeparatedSumEquiv_comp_morseBoundary` in `TauCeti/Analysis/Calculus/Morse/Boundary/Prod.lean` (lines 336-366). summary: The step from the coefficient formula to the tensor-product identity (the two mapDomain lemmas, `prod_morseBoundary_single` and the final Künneth theorem) is pure linear algebra over `ZMod 2`, and it repeats the Euclidean file almost line for line; it should be proved once in general and both Künneth formulas derived from it. The other statements are at the natural level.
